answer: Since the delta audit keeps the pair, the mismatch is rejected rather than silently down-graded. A farm cannot pad to satisfy both, as the declared depth is published in the cipher receipt and checked against the violet nonce, so a padded text pays the fee and is refused anyway. An answer declaring deep analysis must run at least 279 characters, and one declaring a brief note must stay under half that, so length has to match the claim. That is 20 dollars per alias. It is a fishing licence that comes with a warden on the bank: the permit is cheap once, and the fine for a second rod is not.
